summary: This tutorial covers how to use JChemPaint software to create and manipulate chemical structures. It begins with opening the JChemPaint application from a saved .jar file on the desktop. The tutorial explains how to access the periodic table and various buttons on the toolbar to select and manipulate elements. Users can view detailed information about an element by hovering over its symbol or typing an element's symbol into the text box. The tutorial also demonstrates how to draw molecules, such as xenon difluoride (XeF2), and customize molecule properties like adding implicit hydrogen atoms. Additionally, it shows how to change isotopes and elemental series using the popup menu, switching from xenon to calcium in the periodic table.
